title: Woman in Winter Coat & Headscarf, 1947 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor winter portrait of a smiling young woman standing in the snow beside a brick residential house on November 23, 1947. She is dressed in a dark wool overcoat, white gloves, fur-trimmed boots, and a patterned babushka headscarf, exemplifying post-World War II American winter street style.
